name: 95-font-feature-settings
css: body { margin: 0; padding: 0; font-family: "builtin_song"; font-size: 24px; line-height: 1.6; } p { margin: 8px 0; } .kern-off { font-feature-settings: "kern" 0; } .kern-on { font-kerning: none; font-feature-settings: "kern" 1; } .multi { font-variant-ligatures: none; font-feature-settings: "liga" on, 'ss01' 1, "kern" off; } .palt { font-feature-settings: "palt" 1; } .normal { font-feature-settings: normal; }
html:
默认字偶距 AVATAR To. WA LT P, F.

关闭字偶距 AVATAR To. WA LT P, F.

显式开启 AVATAR To. WA LT P, F.

多特性 Abc AVATAR To. Wa

比例宽度 Abc AVATAR，标点「引号」。
